title: 3 Stocks That Could EXPLODE From the China AI Ban
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: FCC likely to restrict Chinese 3.2T transceivers with a 65% US-content exception, turning Chinese factories into customers of US DSP and laser makers.
Networking spend per GPU rising ~4x in next-gen systems; optics is becoming one of the biggest AI stories.

calls.reason: Dominant US optical DSP supplier (with AVGO); clean consolidation breakout, good sales/earnings growth; just initiated a position.
calls.quote: I just initiated a position uh in this stock along with a couple of others.

calls.reason: Indium-phosphide laser supplier, sold out through 2028, Nvidia $2B investment; 5-month base breaking to new highs. Cites Rosenblatt $1,300 target (analyst's, not his).
calls.quote: We come back in six or 12 months and we see this thing up here at 2,000 or 4,000 or beyond. Okay?

calls.reason: Only US transceiver maker at scale (Texas factories); 50% off May peak, buyers stepped in; dilution and volatility are the risks. Analyst avg target 160s.
calls.quote: I am taking a pilot position in AAOI... pushing back in the mid 100s and potentially to 200 bucks and beyond.

notes: No video date spoken ('This Monday, October 5th' refers to the analyst note), so listing date used. Garbled names: 'Marll' = Marvell (MRVL), 'Lum/Lummentum/Momentum/Li T' = Lumentum (LITE), 'AOI' = Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI). LITE price quoted as ~1,000 then ~1,100. His LITE '2,000 or 4,000' remark is a possibility, not a firm target, so target left null. MRVL ~270 per his '$270 stock'. AAOI horizon for 'mid 100s / 200' unstated; placed in medium term.
